occurrences.key: Current bead and comments were read before implementation; there were no bead amendments or comments. The coordinator explicitly clarified: exact process-tag aliases only, ambiguous cleanup denial must not be conflated with inspection denial, raw label/task/line provenance must remain, and the smallest additive compact fingerprint/provenance suffix is allowed. Those clarifications narrow the frozen brief's illustrative `cleanup-denied` candidate: that candidate stays distinct. The coordinator owns integrated sweep and fresh-agent semantic evaluation. The supplied behavior baseline passed process-alias judgment in both arms, so prompt edits are limited to the operative vocabulary/transport reference and replacement of the existing automatic shared-defect conclusion; no generic judgment prompting or new agent round was added.
